messages.content: Article 21 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to life and personal liberty. Precedents related to Article 21 have established that this right includes the right to live with human dignity, the right to privacy, the right to a fair trial, the right to legal aid, and protection against arbitrary arrest and detention. These precedents have been crucial in shaping the interpretation and application of Article 21 in various legal cases.
